title: Water Damage Mitigation Claims Liaison Memo: Code-Upgrade Supplements and Code Work Covered
content:
**Claims liaison memo — Water Damage Mitigation and Insurance Claim Services code-upgrade supplements**

The code work covered on a Water Damage Mitigation job is the amount of the job's lead-safe setup and asbestos sampling that the dwelling coverage pays through the linked claim file's ordinance or law coverage. A code-upgrade supplement for the job decides its code work:
- when the latest code-upgrade supplement request on the linked claim file names this job and carries a carrier approval, the code work covered is the amount the carrier approved on that request, whether or not it is less than the amount asked, but no more than the ordinance or law limit;
- when that request names this job and has no carrier approval yet, the code work covered is the amount the request asks for, but no more than the ordinance or law limit, while the carrier decides it;
- in any other case no supplement-based change applies.

When the linked claim file carries more than one code-upgrade supplement request, or its code-upgrade supplement request names another job or no job, the regulated-materials amount is set by a human representative.

## Records read
The Insurance Claim Services file the job is linked to: its code-upgrade supplement requests (request date, the job each names, the amount asked), the carrier approvals recorded against the request, and the file's ordinance or law limit (a file that carries no limit has a limit of zero).

## Cases (hypothetical, ordinance or law limit of $1000.00)
| Latest code-upgrade request on the file | Code work covered |
|---|---|
| names this job, asks $500.00, carrier approved $350.00 | $350.00 |
| names this job, asks $1400.00, carrier approved $1200.00 | $1000.00 (held to the limit) |
| names this job, asks $800.00, no approval yet | $800.00 |
| names this job, asks $1300.00, no approval yet | $1000.00 (held to the limit) |
| no code-upgrade request on the file | no supplement-based change |
| names another job or no job, or the file carries more than one such request | set by a human representative |
